Package com.ascend.testlab.client.postgresql

Interface PgReaderClient

All Known Implementing Classes:
PgReaderClientImpl
public interface PgReaderClient
Interface for the client to interact with PostgreSQL reader database. Contains methods to fetch data from the database.
